title: $\mathbb{A}^1$-Euler Characteristic of Low Symmetric Powers and Split Toric Varieties
summary: For a smooth, projective scheme $X$ over a field $k$ or any variety $X$ if $k$ has characteristic zero, we compute the compactly supported $\mathbb{A}^1$-Euler characteristic of $\operatorname{Sym}^2(X)$ if $\operatorname{char}(k) \ne 2$ and of $\operatorname{Sym}^3(X)$ if $\operatorname{char}(k) \ne 2,3$. We do so by extending the definition of a $G$-equivariant quadratic Euler characteristic first studied by Pajwani-Pál to arbitrary characteristic and by studying its relation to the $\mathbb{A}^1$-Euler characteristic of quotients.
